{{Quote|Without fear, and with serenity in my heart, I enter the dark. I will know. I must know.|Arlo Grennen|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Arlo Grennen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Grennen decided to investigate the influence of the [[dark side of the Force]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and searched through the libraries of the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)|Jedi Temple]] on<ref name="Legacy 1" /> the planet<ref name="Tython">{{TORcite|type=codex|Tython}}</ref> [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to find information on the moon before heading there himself.<ref name="Legacy 1" />

Grennen recorded his research in a journal, documenting the moon's history with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], including the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]<ref name="Legacy 2">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|The Dark Legacy of Yavin 4: Part II}}</ref> and the fallen [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] [[Freedon Nadd]]<ref name="Legacy 3">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|The Dark Legacy of Yavin 4: Part III}}</ref> and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].<ref name="Legacy 4">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|The Dark Legacy of Yavin 4: Part IV}}</ref>

However, the longer he stayed on the moon, the more the influence of the dark side corrupted the Jedi Master, and he believed that he would be the next in line to inherit the dark side from Exar Kun; however, he was driven mad by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]<ref name="Legacy 5">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|The Dark Legacy of Yavin 4: Part V}}</ref> sometime between [[3640 BBY]] and [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Grennen [[Force vision/Legends|foresaw]] the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|arrival]] of the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], and vowed to do everything he could to stop Revan from destroying the Emperor, but the Emperor ignored Grennen's devotion and absorbed the Jedi Master's essence, killing Grennen.<ref name="Legacy 5" />
